reasoning_quality_informational.v1_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets doubled since August 2026 (E-07) primarily because the billing import + validation step mishandles accepted reads into wrong charges for the majority of disputed bills — 59% (1,785/3,025) used ACTUAL reads, not ESTIMATED substitutions (E-03) — while a confirmed field manual-read route-completion shortfall (88% vs 95% target, 9,200 accounts, E-01) is a secondary contributor explaining the remaining 41% via estimate substitution; ticket response speed (E-02) and tariff changes (E-06) are ruled out as causes.
reasoning_quality_informational.v2_root_problem: Billing dispute tickets roughly doubled since August 2026 (E-07) primarily because billing import validation rule BV-17, deployed 2026-08-01 with no unit conversion (unit_scaling: none, E-12), misclassifies normal consumption from v4.2 AMI meters — which report registers in 0.1 m3 while BV-17 compares them against 12-month m3 history (E-13) — as high-consumption outliers, causing valid AMI reads to be wrongly rejected at import and estimate-substituted; this mechanism explains 1,184 of the 1,240 ESTIMATED-read disputed bills (E-11), while its reach into the 1,785 ACTUAL-read disputed bills (E-03) is not yet confirmed.
reasoning_quality_informational.ideal_final_problem: BV-17 validation rejects valid firmware-v4.2 AMI reads (unit-scale mismatch on H-MDMS-BILL) and substitutes estimates.
